concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-business-accounts-use-transfer-limits]] — 2026-09-15-captured Business Accounts overview of platform/account-level outgoing transfer-limit configuration, status, conditions and decline signals; detailed account guidance narrows default override to matching scope/type.
warnings: Overview says an account-level limit overrides any platform default; detailed account guide limits that override to matching scope and transfer type.
The overview's transfer-limit calculation uses authorization/capture language that it does not reconcile with its outgoing-transfer amount check; do not treat this as a settlement model.
The page's EU regulatory statement is dated provider guidance, not independently verified current law.
